United Airlines resolved a widespread system outage, days after a previous nationwide ground stop disrupted air travel.
A judge scheduled a spring retrial for Lindsay Clancy, who faces charges related to her children's deaths.
Aidan Hutchinson reportedly has a torn ACL with no additional damage, impacting his football season.
Joe Burrow is performing exceptionally, potentially achieving one of the greatest passing seasons in NFL history.

idiom.title: Go the extra mile
idiom.interpretationEn: This phrase originates from the New Testament in the Bible, specifically Matthew 5:41, where Jesus said, “If anyone forces you to go one mile, go with them two miles.” The meaning behind this is that when you are asked to do something, you should put in extra effort. Today, the idiom is used to describe people who are willing to go beyond the minimum requirement to achieve higher goals or provide better service.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个短语源自《新约圣经》中《马太福音》第五章 41 节，其中耶稣提到 “有人强逼你走一里路，你就同他走二里”。这句话的意思是，当你被要求完成一些事情时，应该多做一点，多付出一些努力。现在，这个习语常用于表示人们不满足于完成最基本的任务，而是愿意付出额外的努力来达到更高的目标或提供更好的服务。

examples.en: She always goes the extra mile to help her students succeed.
examples.zh: 她总是加倍努力帮助她的学生取得成功。

examples.en: Our customer service team goes the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction.
examples.zh: 我们的客户服务团队总是多做一点，以确保客户满意。

examples.en: I’m so grateful to my colleagues who went the extra mile to complete the project on time.
examples.zh: 我非常感激我的同事们，他们加倍努力按时完成了这个项目。

people.name: Ioannis Bourousis
people.extract: Ioannis Bourousis, commonly known as Giannis Bourousis is a Greek former professional basketball player and basketball executive. He is the general manager of the Greek basketball club ASK Karditsa. During his playing career, at a height of 7 ft 3⁄4 in tall and a weight of 270 lb. (122 kg), Bourousis played at the center position. Bourousis, who was a two-time All-EuroLeague First Team selection, was compared to FIBA Hall of Fame / Basketball Hall of Fame center Vlade Divac, by San Antonio Spurs' head coach Gregg Popovich.
highlights: Former Greek professional basketball player and executive.
General manager of Greek basketball club ASK Karditsa.

people.name: Stephen Root
people.extract: Stephen Root is an American actor. Known for his extensive work in film and television, he gained attention for his roles as Jimmy James on the NBC sitcom NewsRadio (1995–1999), as Milton Waddams in the comedy film Office Space (1999), and voiced Bill Dauterive and Buck Strickland on the animated series King of the Hill.
highlights: Actor known for Jimmy James on NewsRadio.
Played Milton Waddams in the film Office Space.
Voiced characters on animated series King of the Hill.

people.name: Doug Walker (comedian)
people.extract: Douglas Darien Walker is an American film critic, comedian, YouTuber, filmmaker, and actor. He is best known for creating and starring in the satirical film review series Nostalgia Critic, wherein the title character reviews nostalgic media in an exaggeratedly aggressive manner. After an initial run on YouTube, Walker co-created the website That Guy with the Glasses in 2008, where he and the series gained wider popularity. The site also presented other media critics who created similar content, including Lindsay Ellis and Angry Joe. Walker and his series returned to YouTube in 2014.
highlights: Creator and star of Nostalgia Critic review series.
Co-created website That Guy with the Glasses.
Reviews nostalgic media in an exaggeratedly aggressive manner.
